title: Grenades
html:
Grenades are Consumables which can be  Thrown to deal Damage, inflict Conditions, create Surfaces, Knock back creatures, or produce other effects. Most Coatings, Elixirs, and Potions can also act as Grenades when thrown. Many grenades also can explode.

Overview

Most grenades trigger their respective effects when destroyed, usually through the 1⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage dealt to light items when thrown. However, grenades dropped in the world can also be triggered by any other sources of damage, such as attacks, damaging surfaces (e.g.  Fire) or other grenades.

Multiple grenades in one item stack detonate identically to a single grenade. Thus, it is advisable to first split the item stack into single items prior to usage.

When placed in destructible containers, multiple grenades can be thrown at once by throwing the container. However, grenades dispersed in this way do not take damage from the throw and must be triggered manually by a secondary damage source.

Grenades can be looted, bought from vendors, or crafted with the Alchemy system. Some grenades can only be acquired through some, but not all of these methods.
